title: Show autofill search hint
prompt:
In lib/widgets/autocomplete_type_ahead.dart, remove the invisible label so Flutter displays the existing hint when the field is empty and unfocused. Replace these exact lines:
```dart
          label: Semantics(label: widget.hint, child: const SizedBox.shrink()),
          hintText: widget.hint,
```
with:
```dart

```
Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
